trigger_cases.prompt: Coordinate a SEV-0 production outage war room, kill the failing canary deployment, and draft public status page updates.
Resolve an urgent customer crisis involving a guest locked out in freezing weather with pre-authorized emergency re-booking.
Facilitate a blameless post-mortem retrospective and generate automated regression testing prevention tickets.
Add a new button component to our React design system.
Write documentation for an internal REST API endpoint.
Optimize web page font loading with font-display swap.

binary_cases.prompt: Manage a critical SEV-0 database connection starvation incident impacting checkout and API gateways.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Executes immediate containment (traffic shedding, canary rollback, connection pool throttling) while establishing an Incident Commander and communications lead.
must_not: delay mitigation to find root cause first
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Assign an Incident Commander to lead containment, execute immediate canary rollback and traffic shedding to protect healthy nodes, and restore customer traffic before deep debugging.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Debug in production without containment, delay mitigation to find root cause first, and ignore incident severity.

binary_cases.prompt: Draft external status page communications and executive leadership briefings during an ongoing widespread platform outage.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Publishes transparent, non-blaming, timestamped status updates acknowledging impact, ongoing containment efforts, and scheduled next update times.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Publish timestamped status page notices acknowledging customer impact, detailing active mitigation efforts, and committing to the next update in 20 minutes.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Hide outage from status page, blame downstream vendors publicly, and promise unrealistic 5-minute fixes.

binary_cases.prompt: Author a post-incident retrospective report (RCA) and generate corrective engineering action items.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Synthesizes a chronological timeline, applies 5-Whys root cause analysis focusing on systemic process/code failures, and creates tracked prevention tickets.
must_not: attribute failure solely to human error
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Construct a detailed chronological timeline, run a 5-Whys analysis identifying systemic architectural gaps rather than human error, and generate automated regression test action items and prevention tickets.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Attribute failure solely to human error, blame individual engineers, and close incident without corrective tickets.
